subject: English
stimulus: (a) Historical places help us ⎯⎯. (b) Man is curious ⎯⎯. (c) ⎯⎯, he can know many things. (d) We should pay a visit to a historical place ⎯⎯. (e) It is high time ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Historical places help us know the history of a place. (b) Man is curious to know the unknown and see the unseen. (c) If a man visits historical places, he can know many things. (d) We should pay a visit to a historical place whenever we get chance. (e) It is high time we paid a visit to a place of historical importance.
